title: BillboardGui MaxDistance and world decoration polish
description: Restrict egg station BillboardGuis visibility with MaxDistance (pet chances = 12, station label = 25, zone gate = 25). Remove small individual flowers (pink/gray spheres that look bad). Keep trees, rocks, and planter clusters.
steps: Add MaxDistance = 12 to PetChancesLabel BillboardGui in ZoneService._spawnEggStations
Add MaxDistance = 25 to StationLabel BillboardGui in ZoneService._spawnEggStations
Add MaxDistance = 25 to GateLabel BillboardGui in ZoneService._spawnZoneGates
Remove the 20 individual flower/stem spawning loop from ZoneService._spawnZone1Deco
